column4: The only forms are the newsletter and waitlist sign-ups, which post by navigation to Buttondown's endpoint, with double opt-in there; the site has no session and no state of its own to forge.
The cookie is CF_Authorization, Cloudflare Access's own, set only while the hosts sit behind Access (until the cutover); pyeconomics sets no cookie.

Pages are served public, max-age=0, must-revalidate by Workers static assets on purpose, so a deploy reaches every visitor at once.
